behavior: Agile aerial forager that catches insects in flight and swoops to take prey from land or the water surface; rarely plunge-dives. Nests colonially in shallow ground scrapes.
field_marks: White head with a dark eye patch in nonbreeding plumage
Pale gray upperparts and white underparts
Long, pointed wings and a short, shallowly forked tail
habitat: Coasts, salt marshes, lagoons, mudflats, sandbars, sandy islands, and open wetlands or fields near water.
